name: E-commerce microservices baseline
query: Design a microservices architecture for an e-commerce platform with cart, catalog, orders, payments, and notifications.

name: URL shortener reference coverage
query: Design a URL Shortening service like TinyURL. Focus on: unique short ID generation, collision avoidance, malicious URL prevention, abuse rate limiting, link expiration/deletion, analytics logging, cache strategy (Redis/CDN), and hot key handling.

name: Instagram reference coverage
query: Design a system design for Instagram. Include feed generation strategy, media upload and processing pipeline, timeline caching, metadata storage, object storage, CDN edge delivery, and direct client media retrieval.

name: Cloud drive reference coverage
query: Design a system like Dropbox or Google Drive with sync clients, delta/chunk-based resumable upload, strongly consistent metadata service, block/chunk service, object storage durability strategy, and real-time device sync notifications.

name: Twitter reference coverage
query: Design Twitter/X for hundreds of millions of users with tweet ingest, Snowflake-like ID generation, NoSQL timeline storage, Redis timeline cache, hybrid fan-out (push for regular users and pull for celebrities), and async feed distribution via Kafka-like pub-sub.

name: Rate limiter reference coverage
query: Design a distributed API rate limiter with external clients, load balancer, multiple limiter nodes, centralized Redis state with atomic operations, explicit allow/block decision path including HTTP 429 handling, and admin rule synchronization.
